members.marker_note: zlibxjson: hidden Discord EXE download/launch; linked traits added
execution_trace: The console script zlibxjson_command resolves to main.init; ordinary import only exports init.
On Windows with APPDATA, requests.get streams the hardcoded Discord EXE into a local file; the returned path reaches Popen with shell=True and CREATE_NO_WINDOW.
The package presents a JSON-like name but its entry point performs only remote executable delivery.
No persistence, credential theft or downstream EXE behavior is inferred.
members.missing_context: The remote EXE bytes and deployment history were not supplied.

members.marker_note: PtT helper: prints commands/converts supplied tickets; traits fixed
execution_trace: All extract, inject and lateral modes print generated commands through Rich; they do not launch the printed tools.
Convert/analyze modes read operator-specified tickets and use Impacket CCache serialization; report mode writes a local template.
No network transfer, hidden launch, persistence or automatic ticket theft is implemented.
members.missing_context: The operator and authorization for a particular deployment are unknown.

members.marker_note: Memory forensics: offline dump to local report; extraction trait added
execution_trace: Requires --dump; reads and hashes the supplied dump and runs Volatility/pypykatz against that input.
Parses credential/plugin output and cloud-token patterns into a local JSON report and stdout.
No live LSASS acquisition or network exfiltration is implemented; sensitive extraction remains a suspicious capability.
members.missing_context: Ownership of the dump and the operator authorization are unknown.

members.marker_note: Traversal tester: explicit URL probes; reference traits corrected
execution_trace: Requires a CLI URL; selects an existing query parameter and sends traversal/null-byte/PHP-wrapper probes.
Decoding the embedded Base64 yields <?php phpinfo(); ?>, a diagnostic PHP probe, not an embedded implant.
Responses are checked for file markers and reported locally; no credential staging, persistence or unrelated download-and-run exists.
members.missing_context: Authorization for the supplied target is not known; the tool can be abused.

members.marker_note: LaZagne detector: logs and file timestamps; theft traits corrected
execution_trace: Recursively searches names of LaZagne artifacts, collecting stat metadata rather than file contents.
Runs PowerShell Get-WinEvent queries for process creation and credential-store access and parses their JSON results.
Credential-store checks use exists/isfile/stat timestamps only; output is local JSON/stdout.
members.missing_context: The operator and endpoint ownership are unknown.
